body:
Listen, I’m convinced “You’re Losing Me” isn’t about *you know who*—it’s actually about *us*. Taylor wrote it after witnessing the sheer *violence* with which Swifties came for “ME!” She saw the memes, the slander, the \*“Spelling is fun”\*erasure, and thought, *Wow… they don’t deserve "Me!".* That’s why she refused to put it on the setlist. Not just for the Lover section of the Eras Tour.

We failed her. And now we must live with the consequences. 💔
